checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add canonical score concatenation

impact_assessment.why: Distinct phrases can be joined as audio or looped, but there is no way to merge several score files into one editable arrangement.
impact_assessment.benefits: concat merges multiple scores into one canonical source with correct time offsets, preserving the first score's global settings.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a single input must be byte-identical, offsets must use each score's duration, and empty input must fail clearly; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure concat module with identity, offset and round-trip byte tests, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 203 tests green; concat identity, offsets and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-concat' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV sample-rate conversion

impact_assessment.why: Rendered audio is locked to one sample rate; resampling is needed to feed other tools or match a target device.
impact_assessment.benefits: resample converts any Coda WAV to a target rate with deterministic linear interpolation, keeping a valid WAV header.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: same-rate input must be byte-identical, frame counts must be rounded correctly, and invalid rates must fail clearly; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure resample module with identity, ratio and interpolation byte tests, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 208 tests green; same-rate identity, ratio-based frame counts and interpolation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-resample' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add stereo channel operations

impact_assessment.why: Stereo WAVs can only be rendered with per-note pan; there is no way to fold to mono, swap channels or isolate a side after rendering.
impact_assessment.benefits: channels provides mono/swap/left/right operations on any Coda WAV with deterministic frame math.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: operations must be exact frame transformations, reject unknown modes, and preserve length and sample rate; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure channels module with exact frame-vector tests, a CLI mode option, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 214 tests green; mono/swap/left/right frame math and length preservation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-channels' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add 8-bit WAV export

impact_assessment.why: Some retro tooling and embedded targets require 8-bit PCM; Coda currently only writes 16-bit.
impact_assessment.benefits: bitdepth converts Coda WAVs to 8-bit unsigned PCM with a correct header, while --bits 16 remains an exact identity.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sample mapping must be exact (0 -> 128, 1 -> 255, -1 -> 0), header fields must match 8-bit PCM, and invalid inputs must fail clearly; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure bit-depth module with header and sample byte-vector tests, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 219 tests green; 8-bit header, sample mapping and 16-bit identity pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-bitdepth' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: c551142ab522bdad51ee03fa41b691cd341a4024

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a root-key option for seeded composition

impact_assessment.why: Generated pieces are always rooted at C; choosing a key at generation time is more direct than transposing after the fact.
impact_assessment.benefits: seed --root D4 transposes the generated arrangement by the semitone offset from C, deterministically, before any output is written.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the offset must be applied uniformly, an invalid root must fail clearly, and omitting --root must keep existing golden output; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse the existing transpose function with an offset parsed from the note name, add byte-digest tests, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 220 tests green; root C4 identity, D4 shift and invalid-name rejection pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-seed-root' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 728d0e9e3a9ddfe515fb4ffd475fedae76a458e1

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a score-to-audio verification command

impact_assessment.why: There is no direct way to confirm that a WAV still matches its source score after a chain of edits or effects.
impact_assessment.benefits: verify re-renders a score with the current settings and compares bytes to a WAV, reporting the first differing byte for deterministic diagnosis.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a matching file must pass, a single-byte change must be located exactly, and usage/IO errors must use distinct exit codes; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure comparison helper with exact byte-offset tests, a CLI command reusing the render path, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 224 tests green; verify match, byte-offset mismatch and exit codes pinned by tests
Task 'coda-verify' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 107fe11dc23f1f54a0308f77da6375a0ddea818a

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a CODA provenance chunk in WAV files

impact_assessment.why: Rendered audio carries no record of its source; a stamp makes each WAV explain which score digest produced it.
impact_assessment.benefits: stamp appends a small CODA chunk with score digest, note count and tempo, and stamp-info reads it back, without disturbing audio data.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the RIFF size must be updated, audio bytes must be unchanged, missing chunks must report cleanly, and invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure stamp module with round-trip and header byte tests, two CLI commands, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 229 tests green; CODA chunk round-trip, RIFF size and unchanged audio bytes pinned by byte tests
